theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (d ϑ : Euclid P → ℝ) (a : Euclid P) (t : ℝ), 0 < t → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μ K < ∞) → AEStronglyMeasurable d μ → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, |d x| ≤ 1) → Continuous ϑ → HasCompactSupport ϑ → (∀ x, 0 ≤ ϑ x) → (∀ x : Euclid P, ‖x‖ < 3 → ϑ x = 1) → (∫⁻ x in ball a (3 * t), ENNReal.ofReal (1 - |d x|) ∂μ) / ENNReal.ofReal (t ^ 2) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (t⁻¹ ^ 2 * ∫ x, ϑ (dilation a t x) ∂μ - |t⁻¹ ^ 2 * ∫ x, ϑ (dilation a t x) * d x ∂μ|)
